headline: Blinkit Transition to First-Party (1P) Owned Inventory Model
before_event_treatment: 3P Marketplace Agency Model: Blinkit acted as an intermediary connecting third-party sellers with buyers. Revenue was recognized as net commissions, customer delivery fees, handling fees, and merchant advertising.
after_event_treatment: 1P Principal Inventory Model (Ind AS 115 / IFRS 15): Blinkit purchases, owns, and holds inventory in dark stores. Gross merchandise value of goods sold is recorded directly as Adjusted Revenue. Merchandise purchase costs are recognized in COGS.
original_disclosure: In Q2FY26, Blinkit restructured its operating model to take inventory ownership across high-velocity product categories. Reported Adjusted Revenue surged from ₹1,061 Cr in Q1FY26 to ₹2,423 Cr in Q2FY26 (+128% QoQ, +312% YoY) due to gross merchandise recognition. Sales from Hyperpure to Blinkit became internal eliminations.
financial_impact_quantified: Adjusted revenue expanded by +₹1,362 Cr QoQ; Hyperpure external revenue dropped 55% due to intercompany elimination.
lfl_adjustment_methodology: BLOCKED: Management did not disclose product-level merchant purchase prices (COGS). Fabricating an estimated 3P commission rate without auditable invoice data violates financial data integrity standards. Peer comparison of reported revenue against Swiggy 3P marketplace revenue is strictly prohibited.
unresolved_limitations: External analysts cannot reconstruct exact 3P take rates for Blinkit post-Q1FY26 without proprietary wholesale vendor contracts.

headline: Acquisition of Entertainment Ticketing Business (Paytm Insider / TicketNew) & District Launch
before_event_treatment: Organic Dining-Out Directory: Zomato Dining Out focused on restaurant discovery, table reservations, and dining payment vouchers (Zomato Pay).
after_event_treatment: Comprehensive Going-Out / Entertainment Platform: Consolidated live event ticketing, movie bookings, and concert experiences following the ₹2,048 Cr acquisition of Paytm's entertainment ticketing business, rebranded as District.
original_disclosure: Transaction closed on August 27, 2024. Going-out numbers for Q2FY25 incorporate ~1 month of acquired ticketing business, and Q3FY25 incorporates the full quarter. In Q2FY25, like-for-like YoY GOV growth was 53% compared to 171% headline reported growth.
financial_impact_quantified: Headline GOV grew 171% YoY in Q2FY25, of which organic like-for-like growth was 53% (inorganic bump: ~118% pts).
lfl_adjustment_methodology: Disclosed Organic Growth Anchor: Use Eternal's disclosed 53% YoY like-for-like organic growth rate for Q2FY25 to isolate the acquired ticketing volume from the core dining directory business.
unresolved_limitations: Ticketing margins vs dining-out margins are not separately broken down in note disclosures.

headline: Sale of Stake in Lynks & Supply Chain Deconsolidation
before_event_treatment: Consolidated B2B Logistics: Lynks logistics operations were fully consolidated in Swiggy's Supply Chain segment revenue and EBITDA.
after_event_treatment: Deconsolidated Equity Investment: Swiggy divested its controlling stake. Lynks ceases to be consolidated from Q3 FY27 onwards.
original_disclosure: Swiggy completed the sale of its stake in Lynks during Q2FY27. Lynks ceases to be consolidated from Q3FY27 onwards, resulting in an expected ~₹20 crore quarterly adjusted EBITDA benefit in the Supply Chain segment.
financial_impact_quantified: Estimated recurring ~₹20 Cr quarterly EBITDA improvement from eliminating Lynks operating losses; ~₹200 Cr quarterly revenue reduction.
lfl_adjustment_methodology: Scope Normalization: Adjust pre-Q3FY27 Supply Chain revenues down by ~₹200 Cr per quarter and add back ~₹20 Cr EBITDA to assess core restaurant merchant procurement efficiency without third-party trucking drag.
unresolved_limitations: Exact month-by-month transition in Q2 FY27 involves minor closing date stub adjustments.

headline: Swiggy Dineout Formal Segment Carve-Out and Expansion
before_event_treatment: Dineout numbers were partially reported within other platform services or consolidated without standalone quarterly run-rates.
after_event_treatment: Standalone Segment Reporting: Out-of-Home established with distinct GOV run-rate milestones (targeting ₹10,000 Cr annualised by FY29).
original_disclosure: Swiggy carved out Out-of-Home as an independent core reporting segment following Dineout expansion to 40+ cities, incorporating dining vouchers, table bookings, and SteppinOut live event ticketing.
financial_impact_quantified: Established baseline segment GOV starting at ~₹650 Cr quarterly.
lfl_adjustment_methodology: Compare to Eternal District with appropriate geographic footprint and live ticketing adjustments.
unresolved_limitations: Historical numbers pre-FY25 are not fully restated on a quarterly basis in IPO filings.
